in_sanskrit.name: प्राकृति
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The primal or original form of matter, nature, or the universe. The creator or sustainer of the physical world. A female deity who personifies nature, the earth, or the elements. A creator or shaper of anything, be it a work of art or a child.

in_marathi.name: Prakriti
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Nature, Element, Creation
in_marathi.long_meaning: Prakriti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Prakriti is a Sanskrit term derived from the root word prakruti, meaning natural or inherent. It refers to the material world, the creative force that underlies all existence, and the intrinsic nature of things. Prakriti is often personified as the Goddess of Nature, who is the source of all elements and the foundation of the universe.
